scope: Retained development attempts; none substitutes for final v27-acceptance-* evidence.

inputAttempt.result: Held-drag timeout at small 150% fixture; two prior captures retained. Fixture replacement I/O was investigated; run did not reach final IPC checks.

fixtureWriterProbe.result: 300 replacements per method; both Move-Item -Force and File.Replace caused transient unavailable reads. File.Replace was not adopted; Move(overwrite) experiment also encountered access denial. Provider now bounds retries for transient I/O, while malformed data and persistent failures stay fail-closed.

supersededIdle.result: Raw 0.000000% and rounded 0.0%; repeated on the final binary separately because the fixture reader changed.

removedExperiment: In-memory WebView2 CapturePreview did not establish a useful cold-frame improvement; implementation removed, v27-native-preview evidence retained.

inputSecondAttempt.result: Cancellation before first web preparation retained an allocated idle WebView with no hit rectangle, paint owner or acknowledgement; fixture-read retries were zero. Fixed native-owned cancellation without waiting for an unprepared page.

inputThirdAttempt.result: All 12 geometry/held-drag cases and four captures passed; input page did not appear within the former six-second helper deadline. Allocation now defers until the old Tauri window registration disappears and wakes on destruction. Helper deadline now matches the 15-second native driver deadline, with failure snapshots.

inputFourthAttempt.result: All 12 geometry/held-drag cases and four captures passed. Real input bridge opened, but native present(Drop) cleared React dropReturn; empty synthetic drop later closed the page. Reducer now preserves the return state, and five existing transition cases cover repeated/native-first acknowledgements. Helper additionally asserts restoration of Expanded and reapplies its synthetic compact geometry.

visibilityAttempt.result: All 28 native scenarios/captures passed, but helper asserted 0.35 while computed opacity was 0.67421 during the required 200ms fade. Checker now waits for settled computed opacity without disabling motion.

supersededNativePasses.input: v27-input-accepted (17 cases, actual IPC/caller/style/drag checks, 2 far / 37 near samples, graceful/no downloads)
supersededNativePasses.visibility: v27-visibility-accepted (28 cases + actual WebView bridge, 2 fallback samples, graceful/no downloads)
supersededNativePasses.reason: Both passed before the final location-hook removal; current executable reruns are pinned separately.

idleSameForegroundFailure.result: 0.285152% of one core / 0.3% rounded; main thread 0.1875 CPU seconds, worker zero, no foreground switch. Location hook callback delivery cost remained despite filtering. Removed high-volume location hook, preserving foreground/move/minimise events and the 500ms geometry/notification fallback.

surfaceLegacyHelper.result: Native compact captures passed, but the old helper expected Search island as a textbox alongside Clipboard. Current Search is a combobox replacing module content. Updated selector/sequence verify clipboard scroll before Search, Search persistence on reopen, then clipboard restoration after Search closes.

dpi150FirstPass.result: All 49 morphs collected and four native checks completed; the DPI fixture reapplied 150% rather than changing it. Final v27-acceptance-150-reverse changes 150% to100% during animation. First pass retained, not used as proof of a DPI change.

scannerFalsePositive.result: Generic API rule matched the public release SHA-256 after the prose word secrets. Separated/reworded that prose; no rule, allowlist or scanner exception added.
